sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A proposed strategy for RiskMandate: a spectrum of trust walked with each customer.
sections.para: A proposal, still being discussed between RiskMandate's founders: how we would engage a customer, earn their trust and become a player running our code and vaults with them. Six stages, each answering the next question: policies, understand, risk acceptance, contain, manage, and insure, the end game. Acceleration runs through all of them. We are in the first stage.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Eight points: the strategy, six stages, acceleration, where we are.
sections.para: A proposed strategy for RiskMandate, still being discussed, and the path we would walk with each customer. Policies first, a microcosm of what we do. Then understand the exposure, then risk acceptance, then contain and manage. Then insure, the end game. Acceleration runs through all of it. We are in the first stage, with our first customers.

sections.label: A spectrum of trust
sections.para: A proposal, not yet decided: how we would start engaging a customer, earn their trust and become a player, running our code and vaults with them. Each stage answers a different question the customer has, asked only once the one before is answered. The deeper along, the deeper the relationship. A sequence of events, not always a straight line.

sections.label: The six stages
sections.line: The six stages, and the customer's question at each.
sections.para: Policies: what can this agent do, and what stops it. Understand: what is our exposure. Risk acceptance: which risks we carry, and who decides. Contain: a smaller blast radius. Manage: the agents run as a fleet. Insure: can our agents be covered; by then the evidence an insurer needs, from reach to containment, already exists.

sections.label: Accelerate, all the way through
sections.para: Accelerate was a stage after manage, and it is not one. Every stage lets the business do more with its agents, with more confidence and faster, so acceleration is the reason for the roadmap rather than a step on it.

sections.label: Insurance is the end game
sections.para: Insurance gives the whole path its arc: every stage produces evidence, and insurance is where it is worth the most, to the company and to whoever covers it. So insurers are part of the play from the start, and we want to talk to them now, with this roadmap showing the path from a first policy to agents they can cover.

sections.label: The players at every stage
sections.para: Each stage has companies that should be its big players, in discovering agents, risk management, enforcement, fleet management and insurance. Many we will work with. Where they do not move fast enough, there is an opportunity for us, because we will already be there with the customer.

sections.label: Where we are: the policies
sections.line: Where we are: the policies, with our first customers.
sections.para: Stage one is sorting out the policies and their flows, through the first customers' site at customers.riskmandate.ai. Its seven milestone steps follow the first stage, from credit and one named agent to the usage moment. At v0.1.1 it counts three customers, two started, 3 of 21 steps done, no first policy yet and no credit used.

sections.label: A side note: the policy and its home
sections.line: A side note: the policy and its home.
sections.para: The Agent Behaviour Policy's stewardship moves to the Open Security Summit as its first hosted project; RiskMandate still operates it with customers. The policies are a stepping stone: behaviour, then decision and workflow policies, on the way to being trusted with a customer's agents, from the first policy to agents an insurer can cover.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: It is a proposal, still being discussed between the founders. The stages are a sequence, not a schedule, with no dates, and may overlap. Only the first is under way. No insurer is signed up; the conversations start now. The other players are not named. The counts are the customer site's own, read on 20 October 2026.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: Two voice memos of 20 October 2026; RiskMandate's licence to operate and insurance pages; and customers.riskmandate.ai at v0.1.1, its home page and milestones.
